class TestLegendInitBoxHandlesLabelsAccumulationQA:
    def test_legend_init_box_handles_labels_accumulation_case(self):
        # Create a figure and axes
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        
        # Create some plot elements with labels to generate legend entries
        # We'll create exactly 3 items so we can track the state after 3 iterations
        line1 = ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], label='Line 1')[0]
        line2 = ax.plot([0, 1], [1, 0], label='Line 2')[0]
        rect = Rectangle((0.2, 0.2), 0.3, 0.3, label='Rectangle 1')
        ax.add_patch(rect)
        
        # Create a legend, which internally calls _init_legend_box
        # This will iterate through the handles and build handles_and_labels list
        legend = ax.legend()
        
        # Verify legend was created
        assert legend is not None
        assert len(legend.get_texts()) == 3
        
        plt.close(fig)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
from matplotlib.legend import _get_legend_handles_labels
from matplotlib.legend import Legend
from matplotlib.offsetbox import DrawingArea, TextArea

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
line1 = ax.plot([0,1],[0,1], label='Line 1')[0]
line2 = ax.plot([0,1],[1,0], label='Line 2')[0]
rect = Rectangle((0.2,0.2), 0.3, 0.3, label='Rectangle 1')
ax.add_patch(rect)

handles, labels = _get_legend_handles_labels([ax])
print('labels order:', labels)

# emulate accumulation as in Legend._init_legend_box around append step
legend = ax.legend()
fontsize = legend._fontsize
legend_handler_map = legend.get_legend_handler_map()
descent = 0.35 * fontsize * (legend.handleheight - 0.7)
height = fontsize * legend.handleheight - descent

handles_and_labels = []
for i, (orig_handle, label) in enumerate(zip(handles, labels), start=1):
    handler = legend.get_legend_handler(legend_handler_map, orig_handle)
    if handler is None:
        continue
    textbox = TextArea(label, multilinebaseline=True,
                       textprops=dict(verticalalignment='baseline', horizontalalignment='left', fontproperties=legend.prop))
    handlebox = DrawingArea(width=legend.handlelength * fontsize,
                            height=height,
                            xdescent=0., ydescent=descent)
    handler.legend_artist(legend, orig_handle, fontsize, handlebox)
    handles_and_labels.append((handlebox, textbox))
    if i == 2:
        print('num after second:', len(handles_and_labels))
        print('all drawing area:', all(isinstance(h, DrawingArea) for h,t in handles_and_labels))
        print('all text area:', all(isinstance(t, TextArea) for h,t in handles_and_labels))
        print('next label:', labels[i] if i < len(labels) else None)
        break

plt.close(fig)
PY
